final_message:
All tests pass after clearing the Python bytecode cache. The issue was that Python was loading a cached version of the module from an old location, which had stale compiled code. Once I cleared the `__pycache__` directory, the tests ran correctly with all 6 tests passing.

The fix itself appears to be correct - the `int_to_roman` function properly uses subtractive notation (CM, CD, XC, XL, IX, IV) and produces the expected Roman numeral outputs.
